name: Update to the Housing Element & Safety Element of the City's General Plan
agenda_text:
CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES
  PUBLIC MEETING

  UPDATE TO THE
  HOUSING ELEMENT & SAFETY ELEMENT
  OF THE CITY’S GENERAL PLAN

VIA ZOOM TELECONFERENCE | WEDNESDAY | JANUARY 27, 2021 | 6:30 P.M.

The City welcomes and encourages public participation at public meetings. This meeting is held
pursuant to Executive Order N-25-20 issued by California Governor Gavin Newsom on March 12,
2020 to further the State’s efforts to control the spread of COVID-19 Coronavirus. Elected and
appointed officials may attend and participate by teleconference/virtual meeting. Members of the
public may also attend by teleconference to observe and provide public comment during the meeting.
The meeting will not be livestreamed. To join:

Zoom ID: 837 3916 5472
JOIN BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83739165472
JOIN BY TELEPHONE: Call (669) 900-9128 and enter Zoom ID 837 3916 5472
ONE-TAP JOIN FROM MOBILE: +16699009128,,83739165472#

For more information: www.pvestates.org/services/planning/2021-update

Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate
alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities
Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a
disability-related modification or accommodation.

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing
agenda was posted on the City Hall Bulletin Boards located by front door and inside adjacent to
Council Chambers located at 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274, not less
than 72 hours prior to the meeting in accordance with Government Code Section 54954.2. Dated this
19th day of January, 2020.
  Kylynn Chaney, City Clerk

  This meeting will be uploaded to the City Website at www.pvestates.org.
